name: Jon-Jon's Golden Spyglass
summary: Jon-Jon's Golden Spyglass is among the valuables Sea Wolf MacKinley seeks in Booty Bay. He wants it returned with two other debts from the jungle ruins.

sections.title: A Debt in Gold
sections.body: Sea Wolf MacKinley in Booty Bay wants Jon-Jon's Golden Spyglass returned with two other valuables. Jon-Jon the Crow is one of three debtors MacKinley says vanished into the jungle ruins. Their debts have gone unpaid for months, and MacKinley wants what he is owed.

faq.answer: Sea Wolf MacKinley of Booty Bay wants it back, along with two other valuables owed to him.
Jon-Jon the Crow is one of three debtors MacKinley says wandered into the jungle ruins after their debts went unpaid.

faq.q: Why does MacKinley want the spyglass?
faq.answer: MacKinley says Jon-Jon owes him, and he wants the valuables he is owed returned.

faq.q: Where can Jon-Jon's spyglass be found?
faq.answer: MacKinley points you toward the Ruins of Aboraz and the Ruins of Jubuwal, northeast of Booty Bay, where the debtors wander.

faq.q: What other valuables does MacKinley want?
faq.answer: MacKinley also seeks Maury's Clubbed Foot and Chucky's Huge Ring.

faq.q: What does MacKinley say about the debtors?
faq.answer: MacKinley says he heard the debtors were cursed and bewitched and now wander the jungle ruins.
